Contract CoCoMEOrderProducts::chooseSupplier(supplierID: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		supplier: Supplier = Supplier.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = supplierID)
	precondition:
		supplier.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		CurrentOrderProduct.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		let isLinked: Boolean = (CurrentOrderProduct.Supplier = supplier) in
		result = isLinked
}
